SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 38.852478, -84.223905 (Approximated from intersection)
Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTING A RELEASE OF AN UNKNOWN CHEMICAL ONTO THE GROUND THAT IS KILLING VEGETATION ON THE CALLER"S PROPERTY. CALLER STATED THIS OCCURRED AS A RESULT OF THE ELECTRICAL PROVIDER HIRING A THIRD PARTY CONTRACTOR TO TEND TO/CLEAR BRUSH ALONG THE ROADSIDE THAT MAY EFFECT POWER POLES. THE CONTRACTOR DID NOT APPEAR TO PHYSICALLY CLEAR BRUSH BUT INSTEAD RELEASED SOME MATERIAL THAT HAS KILLED VEGETATION (BRUSH AND TREES) FOR MILES ALONG SEVERAL ROADS IN THE COUNTY AFFECTING THE PERSONAL PROPERTY OF NUMEROUS RESIDENTS. CALLER STATED US-52, SR-743 AND SR-756 ALL HAVE SEVERAL MILES OF DEAD VEGETATION AS A RESULT OF THIS RELEASE. CALLER STATED THE THIRD PARTY CONTRACTOR CONTACTED CALLER TO INQUIRE ABOUT CALLER"S CONCERNS. THE CONTRACTOR WOULD NOT STATE THE PRODUCT USED.
